_provenance.source_description: Curated list of DC-based organizations working on transportation safety, developed via web research and DC Council meeting records.
_provenance.methodology: Organizations identified through Vision Zero DC network, DC ANC records, nonprofit directories, and public websites. Focus areas derived from each organization's stated mission and public materials.
_provenance.notes: This is a representative sample, not an exhaustive directory. Organizations added through council testimony, website visibility, and network recommendations. Future versions should integrate with DDOT and DC Council data systems for canonical listing.

organizations.name: DC Families for Safe Streets
organizations.description: Advocates for life-saving changes and provides support to those affected by deadly crashes. Focuses on victim support and policy changes that might have prevented deaths.
initiatives: Safer Fleets Challenge for government vehicles

organizations.name: DC Transportation Equity Network
organizations.description: Cross-sector coalition committed to ensuring a transportation system that accounts for and protects vulnerable and underserved residents.
initiatives: Investment in pedestrian/bike safety for under-resourced wards

organizations.name: Washington Area Bicyclist Association (WABA)
organizations.description: Transportation advocacy organization focused on completing safe bicycle infrastructure across the region.

organizations.name: DDOT Vision Zero Office
organizations.description: The District government's implementation arm for Vision Zero, coordinating across 30+ agencies on crash prevention through data-driven engineering, education, and enforcement.
initiatives: Speed limit reductions on high-risk corridors

organizations.name: DC Safe Streets Coalition
organizations.description: Community-based coalition bringing neighborhoods together to advocate for safer streets and local transportation improvements.

organizations.name: Ward 8 Bike Alliance & Conservation Groups
organizations.description: Ward-specific organizations prioritizing safer streets and bicycle/pedestrian infrastructure in under-resourced communities.

organizations.name: Coalition for Smarter Growth
organizations.description: Regional leader advocating for walkable, bikeable, and transit-oriented communities as the most sustainable and equitable way for the Washington DC region to grow.

organizations.name: Sierra Club DC — Sustainable Transportation Committee
organizations.description: Regional environmental advocacy focused on decreasing emissions, improving air quality, and increasing traffic safety through transit, biking, and walking infrastructure.
initiatives: Safe bike and pedestrian infrastructure campaigns

organizations.name: Capital Trails Coalition
organizations.description: Coalition working to develop a complete, connected network of regional trails for walking, running, and biking to increase safe active transportation access.

organizations.name: Office of Neighborhood Safety and Engagement (ONSE)
organizations.description: District government office building a community-oriented model for violence prevention and public safety, rooted in public health and neighborhood engagement.
